description_target.target_text: fill blue frame interiors: odd width→orange(7), even→red(2)

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         ;; Find blue (1) frames as objects
         (objs (objects g 0))  ;; non-black components (blue frames)
         (result (make-hash)))
    ;; Copy grid
    (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
      (hash-set! result (list r c) (cell-at g r c)))
    ;; For each frame, find its interior and fill
    (for ((obj objs))
      (let* ((cells (obj-cells obj))
             (rs (map first cells))
             (cs (map second cells))
             (r1 (apply min rs)) (c1 (apply min cs))
             (r2 (apply max rs)) (c2 (apply max cs))
             ;; Interior: inside the frame (r1+1..r2-1, c1+1..c2-1)
             (ir1 (+ r1 1)) (ic1 (+ c1 1))
             (ir2 (- r2 1)) (ic2 (- c2 1))
             (iw (+ 1 (- ic2 ic1)))
             (ih (+ 1 (- ir2 ir1))))
        (when (and (> ih 0) (> iw 0))
          (let ((fill-color (if (= (remainder iw 2) 1) 7 2)))
            (for* ((r (range ir1 (+ ir2 1)))
                   (c (range ic1 (+ ic2 1))))
              (when (= (cell-at g r c) 0)
                (hash-set! result (list r c) fill-color)))))))
    (grid-from-fn h w
      (lambda (r c)
        (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
